name: agent-bridge
description: Launch configurable external agent CLIs as linked child tasks with model, reasoning, session, and result controls.

interface.shortDescription: Run explicitly requested external agent CLIs
interface.longDescription: Run explicitly requested local external-agent CLIs with bounded task status, optional output, follow-ups, and cancellation.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-bridge only when the user explicitly asks to run or consult a configured external agent.
Use run_agent for launch or follow-up and task_status for compact progress.
